name: hud_weather_fx_destructor
description: HudWeatherFx::Destructor frees particle buffers and releases hardware renderer texture/image resources.
known_limits: The class is now source-routed through zVideoFxPass3Element without hand-authored FTable globals; data coverage remains open for vtables/literals/strings, and tier S verification remains deferred.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bde40 validates compiler-generated destructor dispatch-table writes, deleting particleQuads and both particle position buffers when non-null, destroying textureRecord and releasing softwareImage only when g_zVideo_ActiveRendererPath is nonzero, and storing the ReleaseIfNotDefault zero return into softwareImage. The table writes are class-owner evidence modeled by the C++ hierarchy, not source permission for hand-authored production FTable globals.
0x46d5a0 zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault is functionally equivalent under target zvid_image_release_helpers; operator delete is provider-boundary.
The native HudWeatherFx destructor smoke verifies resource release behavior without table-reset identity assertions.
